title: milpa OCI canned-transport contract fixture
description: A checked-in, ordered request/response transcript that BOTH reference impls' OCI-client unit tests replay through their injected transport. It is a unit-tier cross-impl contract (RFC native-oci-fetch §3.7) and is deliberately OUTSIDE conformance/spec-v<N>/ — the black-box conformance corpus cannot observe the token/manifest/blob transport state machine. Same bytes on both sides => same behavior by construction.

description.description: What this transcript exercises (e.g. 'happy token->manifest->blob pull', 'blob digest mismatch', 'ghcr cross-host blob redirect strips Authorization').

exchanges.description: The ordered list of request/response pairs. The fake transport answers each request the client issues, in order, matching on (method, url). A redirect (3xx + Location) is followed by the impl's REAL redirect handler, which issues the next request in this list.

method.description: The request method the client is expected to issue.

url.description: The absolute request URL the client is expected to issue (exact match).

expect_request_headers.description: Assertions on the request the client sends. Maps a header name to its expected value, OR to null to assert the header is ABSENT (used by the redirect Authorization-strip test to prove the bearer token is not forwarded cross-origin).

response.description: The canned response the fake transport returns. At most ONE of body / body_base64 / body_file may be present; absent means an empty body.

headers.description: Response headers (e.g. 'WWW-Authenticate' for a token challenge, 'Location' for a redirect, 'Content-Length').

body.description: Inline UTF-8 response body — for text payloads (Bearer-token JSON, manifests).

body_base64.description: Base64-encoded response body — for binary payloads (a blob whose sha256 must equal the pinned layer digest).

body_file.description: Path, relative to this fixture file, to a sibling file holding the raw response-body bytes — for large or binary blobs kept out of the JSON.
